run_FiDT5_evaluation: run the FiDT5 model evaluation on a test dataset using the evaluate function
run_distributed_reader: run the distributed test reader to evaluate a FiDT5 model across multiple GPUs
evaluate_model_exact_match: evaluate a model on a dataset and compute exact match scores for answers
extract_crossattention_scores: extract cross-attention scores from the FiDT5 model during evaluation on contexts
write_evaluation_results: write model generation results to output files during distributed evaluation
